title: Warm Spanish Double Rise Bread Toast
description: A mustardy, shaggy, lazy-sunday Spanish dish featuring treacle and double-rise-bread, perfect for a relaxing morning, this halal-friendly recipe is a great way to start the day
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the double rise bread into 1 inch thick slices.
In a small bowl, mix together the treacle, unsalted butter, whole grain mustard, sea salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Brush the mixture evenly onto each bread slice.
Place the bread slices onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the beaten egg over the bread slices for a golden glaze.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
